verdict.rationale: Together AI ships a well-documented public REST API (OpenAI-compatible) covering chat, function calling, structured outputs, batch, fine-tuning, dedicated endpoints, images/video, and has official SDKs (TypeScript) plus streaming support, all clearly aimed at programmatic/agentic use. missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found all candidate paths 404) and no independent third-party review specifically validating API robustness/completeness beyond docs and SDK repo.
